summaries.summary: Arizona has required documentary proof of US citizenship to register to vote since 2004. However, some registration records do not have confirmed documentary proof of citizenship due to administrative and system issues. The issues impact voters who obtained a driver's license before 1996 and registered to vote after 2004. These individuals are not confirmed or suspected noncitizens. Rather, these voters were marked as having provided proof of US citizenship when it is not confirmed whether they did or not. The uncertainty is due to the way the motor vehicle division categorized driver's licenses.
